    s = input().strip()
    slow = 0
    fast = 1
    count = 1
    ans = 0

    while fast < len(s):
        ch = s[slow]
        ch1 = s[fast]

        if ch == ch1:
            count += 1
        else:
            if count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            slow = fast
            count = 1
        fast += 1

    if count % 2 == 0:
        ans += 1

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
